summary: SABESP filed a Form 6-K containing its quarterly financial information for the period ended March 31, 2026. This is a routine periodic report of a foreign private issuer, not a special situation. The filing consists of consolidated and individual financial statements (balance sheet, income statement, etc.) with comparative prior period data. No transaction, tender offer, spin-off, activist campaign, restructuring, or other special event is announced or discussed. The filing is mapped to a US 10-Q equivalent for non-US companies. There are no deal terms, no event-driven action, and no risk-arb angle to monitor.
